title: Sunflower Chronicle

outfit_card.silhouette: High-waisted flowing empire dress with a cascading asymmetric layered skirt, decorative ruffled shoulder straps, and a trailing sheer back panel creating a soft pastoral A-line volume.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A lush sunflower crown adorned with golden petals and delicate beaded vines, accented by trailing green ribbons and tiny floral hairpins.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Sheer golden-yellow bodice with intricate embroidered sunflower motifs, a sweetheart neckline framed by ruffled organza, and detached arm cuffs featuring pearl-encrusted lace and fluttering chiffon streamers.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Tiered skirt of translucent yellow chiffon and tulle with scalloped lace hems, layered over a subtle petticoat, paired with delicate golden strappy sandals and sheer ankle socks.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating golden sunflowers and ethereal glowing pollen particles, along with a delicate golden floral bracelet and a vine-wrapped rustic wooden frame accessory.
